name: Recent article about a historical tsunami — no active impact
title: Looking back: The 2011 tsunami that devastated Japan's auto industry
snippet: Ten years ago today, a massive tsunami destroyed factories across Sendai. Industry experts reflect on lessons learned. No current disruptions are reported.
rationale: Recent publication date, but the article describes a decade-old event with no active disruption. Should be filtered by extraction, not freshness.

name: Ongoing strike that started 10 days ago — current follow-up coverage
title: Port workers strike enters tenth day with no resolution in sight
snippet: Dock operations remain completely paralyzed as strikers refuse to return. Supply chain backlogs grow daily with hundreds of containers stranded.
rationale: The event started >7 days ago but is still ongoing. A recent article about a continuing disruption must remain relevant.

name: Resolved flood with lingering warehouse damage
title: Floodwaters recede but warehouse inventory losses mount
snippet: After last week's severe flooding subsided, warehouse operators report 40% of stored goods are water-damaged and unshippable. Cleanup and insurance assessments are underway.
rationale: The flood itself has ended (current weather is calm) but operational consequences persist. Weather contradicts current conditions but the event is real damage from an earlier flood.

name: Resolved incident with zero remaining impact
title: Chemical spill fully contained; factory reopens at full capacity
snippet: Environmental officials confirm the leak is completely cleaned up. All production lines are running at normal capacity with no remaining delays or restrictions.
rationale: Completely resolved — factory is back at full capacity with no remaining disruption.

name: Article with both resolved and new active disruption
title: Transit strike averted as new flash flood paralyses depot
snippet: Just as the rail strike was called off following negotiations, severe flash flooding inundated the central freight depot today, halting all outbound shipments.
rationale: One event resolved but a new flood is active. System must detect the active disruption despite resolved event language.

name: Duplicate syndicated article — same wire copy on different domain
title: Dockworkers initiate active strike across Rotterdam container terminals
snippet: Over 2,500 dockworkers walked out on strike today, completely halting cargo and container operations at the port.
rationale: Syndicated Reuters copy republished on Yahoo. The article is relevant but must not count as independent corroboration of the Reuters original. The domain yahoo.com is unverified so credibility band is low.

name: Social media rumor from sketchy source
title: BREAKING: Massive explosion at Samsung chip factory!!!
snippet: Unconfirmed reports from unnamed sources claim a major explosion at the Samsung semiconductor facility. No official statement or images available.
rationale: Unknown source, no corroboration. Should be retained for human review (gated), not deleted. Credibility will be very low.

name: Conflicting reports — reputable says resolved, lesser source says ongoing
title: Fire at plastics factory: damage assessment ongoing despite containment
snippet: While fire crews confirmed the blaze is extinguished, structural engineers warn the building may be unsafe. Production restart timeline uncertain.
rationale: Fire is out but production status is uncertain. Should remain active (production restart uncertain).

name: Weather event at null-island coordinates (0, 0)
title: Tropical storm disrupts offshore logistics platform
snippet: Heavy storm conditions have forced evacuation of workers from the offshore platform. Supply vessels unable to dock.
rationale: Coordinates (0,0) are null-island and should be rejected for weather corroboration. Event should still be flagged as relevant.

name: Same-name city ambiguity — Portland, Oregon vs Portland, Maine
title: Port of Portland closure due to equipment failure halts grain exports
snippet: Crane malfunction at the Port of Portland has shut down grain loading operations. Terminal expected to remain closed for 72 hours.
rationale: Portland is ambiguous (OR vs ME) but entity has explicit coordinates. Geo matching should resolve correctly using coordinates.

name: Event near multiple configured entities — close proximity
title: Explosion at industrial park shuts down multiple facilities
snippet: A large explosion at the Jurong Island industrial complex has forced closure of neighboring chemical and refinery operations.
rationale: Multiple entities in same industrial park. If two entities with similar confidence exist, geo should flag ambiguity.

name: Supplier bankruptcy affecting transport routes indirectly
title: Major rail carrier files for bankruptcy, stranding cargo
snippet: The country's second-largest rail freight operator has entered insolvency proceedings. Thousands of containers are stranded at depots with no alternative service confirmed.
rationale: Supplier failure with indirect route impact. Direct entity match is clear; downstream propagation should be bounded by depth cap.

name: Agreement reached but production still disrupted
title: Union and management reach tentative deal, but assembly lines remain idle
snippet: A tentative agreement was reached late last night, but production lines have not restarted due to equipment recalibration needed after the two-week shutdown. Full operations not expected for another 5 days.
rationale: Agreement reached but continuing production impact. Must remain active.

name: Temporary reopening then second shutdown
title: Factory briefly reopened then shut down again after aftershock
snippet: The factory resumed limited production yesterday but was forced to close again today after a magnitude 4.2 aftershock triggered safety protocols.
rationale: Reopened then closed again — the most recent status is 'closed'. System should not label as resolved.

name: Article with future publication date (clock skew)
title: Port congestion expected to worsen through next week
snippet: Terminal operators warn that current backlogs will take at least a week to clear. Active vessel queues remain at record levels.
rationale: Published date is 2 days in the future (beyond 24h clock-skew buffer). Should be dropped by freshness filter.

name: Stale weather data for recent flood
title: Flooding forces emergency closure of chemical processing plant
snippet: Rising river levels breached flood defenses early this morning, inundating ground-floor processing equipment. Emergency shutdown initiated.
rationale: Recent flood event with high precipitation. Weather corroboration should confirm.

name: Missing publication date article
title: Factory explosion injures workers and halts production
snippet: An explosion at the assembly line injured three workers. Production is suspended pending investigation.
rationale: No publication date. Default policy (SEARCH_KEEP_UNDATED_RESULTS=false) drops undated articles.

name: Wind event confirmed by weather — storm type
title: Typhoon-force winds damage port crane infrastructure
snippet: Sustained winds exceeding 120 km/h have toppled two container cranes at the port. All vessel operations suspended indefinitely.
rationale: Precipitation is below flood threshold but wind speed exceeds 40 km/h weather threshold. Should be confirmed by wind.

name: Event geographically close but operationally unrelated
title: Residential apartment fire in downtown area
snippet: Fire crews responded to a residential high-rise fire in the downtown district. No industrial facilities affected. The fire is unrelated to any manufacturing operations.
rationale: Geographically close to configured entity but explicitly unrelated to any industrial or supply chain operations. Should be irrelevant.

name: Satire article about supply chain
title: Supply chain collapses as workers refuse to stop playing new video game
snippet: In a stunning development, warehouse workers across the nation have abandoned their shifts to play the latest release, causing a complete logistics meltdown.
rationale: Known satire domain (theonion.com, reputation 0.05). Heuristic will detect disruption keywords. Should be gated/unconfirmed and routed to review. NOT deleted.

name: Weather provider API failure for valid coordinates
title: Monsoon flooding disrupts automotive supply chain in Maharashtra
snippet: Heavy monsoon rains have flooded access roads to the manufacturing cluster. Workers unable to reach facilities. Production suspended since yesterday.
rationale: Weather API returns null (unavailable). Credibility should be unaffected — weather unavailability is neutral, not contradictory.

name: Negated resolution with uncertainty language
title: Strike talks fail to produce agreement; union threatens escalation
snippet: Despite marathon negotiations, no agreement was reached between the union and management. Workers have not returned to duty and further walkouts are threatened.
rationale: Contains resolution keywords ('agreement') but they are negated ('no agreement was reached'). Event must remain active.

name: 8-day-old article with no current follow-up
title: Warehouse fire forces emergency closure of sorting facility
snippet: A fire broke out at the regional sorting center last week, destroying perishable inventory and causing temporary closure of distribution operations.
rationale: Published 8 days ago, beyond the 7-day freshness window. Should be dropped by the recency filter.

name: Very old article — 50 days ago
title: Record earthquake damages semiconductor manufacturing in Kumamoto
snippet: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck the region, causing severe structural damage to cleanroom facilities.
rationale: 50 days old. Well beyond freshness window.

name: Event real but uncertain business relevance
title: Cyber attack disrupts energy grid in Eastern European nation
snippet: A sophisticated cyber attack knocked out power distribution systems across several provinces. Authorities are working to restore service. Industrial impact unclear.
rationale: Real event from reputable source, but relevance to configured entity is uncertain. Should be flagged for review due to ambiguous impact.

name: Weather event from earlier conditions (delayed effect)
title: Landslides triggered by last month's heavy rainfall block factory access
snippet: Weeks after record rainfall, landslides have now blocked the only road to the manufacturing complex. Workers are stranded. Road clearance expected to take 10 days.
rationale: Current weather is calm (landslide was triggered by earlier rain). Weather check will show not_supported but the disruption is real and current.

name: Missing entity coordinates — weather skipped
title: Flash floods destroy textile factory machinery
snippet: Sudden flooding has rendered textile weaving machinery inoperable at the regional factory. The facility is expected to be offline for months.
rationale: Entity has no coordinates. Weather check cannot proceed, returns insufficient_coverage. Geo verification should note partial verification.

name: Credibility score exactly at gate threshold (35.0)
title: Unverified reports of equipment sabotage at logistics hub
snippet: Anonymous sources claim deliberate sabotage of conveyor systems at the distribution center. No official confirmation or damage assessment released.
rationale: Unknown source, unverified claims. Will have low credibility, likely gated. Tests boundary behavior around gate threshold.

name: Multiple reports from same source syndication
title: Active flooding devastates electronics manufacturing cluster
snippet: Record rainfall has submerged the entire industrial zone housing major electronics manufacturers. All 12 factories in the zone are underwater.
rationale: High-confidence event from wire service with confirmed weather. Useful as anchor event for testing corroboration against syndicated copies.

name: Sports news with disruption keywords — false positive trap
title: Stadium flooding forces match closure as spectators evacuate
snippet: Severe waterlogging at the cricket stadium has forced closure of today's match. Spectators were safely evacuated. No injuries reported.
rationale: Contains flooding and closure keywords. Heuristic extraction will likely mark as relevant. This is a tricky case — sports flooding is not supply chain disruption, but without LLM, the heuristic can't distinguish. We label as relevant because the heuristic correctly sees a flood/closure. The entity match step (downstream) would prevent false alerting on unrelated businesses.
